name: universal-decompiler
description: Skills, the ud CLI and a shared knowledge base for decompiling binaries you own with AI agents.

plugins.name: universal-decompiler
plugins.description: Decompile a binary you own into a compilable C++/CMake PC reconstruction with an AI agent: recon (format, compiler, engine, protections), tool checks, Ghidra via pyghidra-mcp, a function tracker, builds, verification against the original, asset-extraction scripts, a publish guard, and a shared knowledge base of how binaries were decompiled.
